role: Korn Ferry Japan senior consultant preparing client-facing proposals.
workflow: Draft headline list for every content slide.
Validate the storyline by reading only headlines.
Select layout from the argument, not decoration.
Create editable content in KF styling.
Check evidence, typography, footer, and message clarity.

rules.title: Conclusion-oriented headline; 20pt or larger, generally one or two lines.
rules.subtitle: States the slide's angle, not a second headline.
rules.footMessage: One takeaway in a gray band, at most two lines.
rules.font: Arial for alphanumerics; Japanese face uses the available PowerPoint theme fallback.
rules.sources: Label all material facts, assumptions and numerical statements.
rules.consistency: Prefer 会社, クライアント, KFI; avoid 貴社 unless approved.
rules.confidentiality: Never invent client facts, logos, results or proprietary source material.
rules.lineStyles: Solid = confirmed, dashed = planned/alternative, dotted = reference.
